response.sql: WITH site_features AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_features), margins AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM margins WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
